cohortBeat: resoluteness → TEMPORALITY horizons. Night-path vertical beams (inherited from death-conscience) fully rejoin at §62, then TURN HORIZONTAL at §65: three ecstasis horizon-lines enter and persist, reworked per chapter, fading to a grey flatline at §71.

chosen.evolution: p3c17 seam-beam (12°) → p3c18 single vertical 0° brightest → p3c19 ring → p3c20 plumb → p3c21 THE TURN (vertical breaks into 3 horizontals + Moment-tick) → p3c22 horizons+4 task ticks → p3c23 compression → p3c24 four-band stack → p3c25 horizons escaping frame + tool-shadow dissolve → p3c26 region-on-horizon → p3c27 grey flatline + one notch.
chosen.name: D1 'The Turn' (CHOSEN)
chosen.why: The cohort's own argumentative event — care's meaning revealed as ecstatic-horizonal temporality — becomes a visible 90° rotation of the book's master image. Future-first ordering (future/having-been/present top-to-bottom) is textually exact (§65 p18-19). The §69 whereto-lines-escaping-frame literalizes 'further outside than any object' (p52) and the horizonal schemata (p47). The §71 diminuendo earns the historicity handoff. Title-swap test: beams rejoining then falling into named ecstasis horizons means nothing on any other book.

considered.name: D2 'Concentric Rings'
considered.rejectedWhy: Rings repeat the death cohort's copper time-ring language and the old Div-Two ◇ seal register — a rejected-pattern echo. The circle belongs to §63 alone ('leap into this circle', p17); stretching it across 11 chapters over-claims a local motif while abandoning the cohort's textually central image (horizons: §§65/69/70). Ring-per-chapter also degrades toward badge-repetition, explicitly banned.
considered.salvage: Single ring kept exactly once, at p3c19, where the prose earns it.

considered.name: D3 'Typographic Score'
considered.rejectedWhy: Openers as giant German display type (Vorlaufen, Augenblick, Wiederholung) with minimal SVG. Fails the twin giants: §§68-69 need spatial landmarks and breathing architecture, not more letterforms. Weak title-swap test — any German philosophy book could wear big Fraunces nouns. Also collides with the binding ghost-numeral system (two competing giant-type voices per opener).
considered.salvage: One attested German landmark term per chapter survives as the margin-rail gloss (small, quiet, English-captioned).

directions.exploredWithin: Book identity is binding (ART-DIRECTION.md); the three directions above explore within the Clearing grammar per cohort-designer role.

p3c17.contentRationale: Hinge chapter (11 paras): anticipation + resoluteness must be brought together 'from within' (p2: start from resoluteness and ask whether it points ahead to anticipatory resoluteness); method pauses 'not to rest, but to gain momentum' (p4). Programmatic preview of §§62-71 (p10). Opener stages two-becoming-one: the death-conscience split beams visibly converging with a seam still showing — the question of the chapter rendered as unfinished joinery. The threshold well carries p0's 'We projected existentially an authentic potentiality-for-being-whole' momentum-gathering pause.
p3c17.flecks: Sparse single fleck-row low in the text column (the pause before momentum); wide breather after p4 region is approximated by a mid-column divider (explicit rule, no para hooks exist).
p3c17.motif: converging twin beams with visible seam
p3c17.openerComposition: Ledger. G: right-bleed '61'. S (slot banner tp-61): two 12° beams converging downward into one shaft; a 1px lichen seam line marks the join for the upper third, dissolving below. T: title flush-left (long title wraps to 3 lines max at 40px min clamp). R: gloss 'Vorlaufen + Entschlossenheit' (both terms attested: Vorlaufen §68 p5, Entschlossenheit throughout) + micro-caption 'two phenomena, one join'.

p3c18.contentRationale: Cohort PEAK before the summit (17 paras): resoluteness 'thought out to its end' (p0); null ground of guilt (p2); death as 'possibility of the impossibility of existence' (p4); situation disclosed 'only in a free act of resolve' (p8); certainty 'keeping oneself free for the possibility of taking it back' (p8); modalization ownmost/nonrelational/insuperable/certain-yet-indefinite (p10); 'sober anxiety' close (p15). Binding note: beams fully rejoined — brightest pre-temporality. Opener is pure severity: one vertical shaft, full slot height, highest shaft-core opacity in the cohort, flanked by two faint afterimage lines (the extinguished split). No ornament anywhere — the chapter's 'relentless severity' (p5) forbids decoration.
p3c18.flecks: NONE. Unbroken severity; the only chapter in the cohort with a clean text column. Breathing comes from paragraph spacing only.

R: gloss 'vorlaufende Entschlossenheit' (attested: 'anticipatory resoluteness' throughout; German compound standard in translations) + micro-caption 'thought out to its end'.

p3c19.contentRationale: Ground chapter (21 paras): fore-having/fore-sight/fore-conception made primordial (p0-1); 'Dasein is ontologically farthest from itself' (p2); interpretation 'has the character of doing violence' (p4); the circle charge answered: 'leaping into this circle primordially and completely' (p17). The ring appears exactly once in the cohort, here, where the prose earns it: the rejoined shaft bends and passes THROUGH a large lichen ring (not around it) — the leap into, not over, the circle. The shaft exits the ring slightly widened: primordiality gained.

p3c21.contentRationale: SUMMIT of the book's argument (25 paras) and most ambitious opener: meaning = 'upon-which of the primary project' (p1-4); 'having-been arises from the future' (p8, p10); 'I-am-as-having-been' (p14); the Moment/Augenblick (p16); 'Temporality is not a being at all. It is not, but rather temporalizes itself' (p16); ecstasies 'toward itself / back to / letting be encountered' (p17); future-first priority within equiprimordiality (p18-19); four theses (p23); vulgar time as 'mere succession of nows' (p17). THE TURN: the vertical beam breaks into THREE HORIZONTAL ecstasis lines (top→bottom = future / having-been / present; future line thickest+brightest = priority; equal spacing = equiprimordiality). A single vertical Moment-tick pierces all three at 62% width ('In the Moment nothing can happen' §68 p9 — the tick is narrow, bright, silent). Faint vertical afterimage at the left edge remembers the beam that turned. Hinge paras p7/9/11/14/17/18/19/21/24 honored by three fleck-rows aligned to the three lines.
p3c21.flecks: Three horizontal fleck-rows in the text column at 25/50/75% scroll, weights matched to the three ecstasis lines (future row brightest) — the horizons descend into the reading body.
p3c21.motif: three horizontal ecstasis lines + piercing Moment-tick (THE TURN)

S (slot banner tp-65, tallest slot in cohort ~1.4× standard): three full-width horizontal lines — future 5px shaft 100%, having-been 3px shaft 70%, present 2px lichen 60%; one vertical Moment-tick (2px, shaft 100%, 40% of slot height) piercing all three at x=62%; faint vertical beam-afterimage (lichen 20%) at x=6%. T: title flush-left. R: gloss 'Augenblick' (attested p16: 'Moment [Augenblick]') + micro-caption 'future first, all equiprimordial'.
p3c21.paletteRole: Full shaft voice: three shaft weights + lichen. Brightest overall opener after §62's single shaft (broader but less concentrated light).
p3c21.readingTreatment: Threshold well on p:first-of-type. Three ecstasis-aligned fleck dividers. Standard 34rem (3214w does not need giant measure; rhythm carries it).
p3c21.title: Temporality as the Ontological Meaning of Care

p3c24.contentRationale: GIANT I (51 paras, 5994w), four subsections: (a) understanding — anticipation vs awaiting, 'awaiting that makes present' (p14), Moment vs making-present (p9-10), repetition vs forgetting (p12); (b) attunement — fear (forgetting that awaits and makes present, p22) vs anxiety (present 'held in readiness', p26), pallid lack of mood (p30-32); (c) falling — curiosity, 'never dwelling anywhere' (p38) as extreme opposite of the Moment; (d) discourse — tenses, 'is' as copula (p47); close: 'a future that makes present, in the process of having-been' (p49). Opener: FOUR stacked horizontal bands (Rothko register) = the four subsections, weights ascending (a) 2px lichen → (b) 3px lichen/shaft → (c) 2px dimmed (falling = dimmest) → (d) 4px shaft (discourse articulates = brightest band). Long-chapter relief per binding note: 38rem measure, breather spacing, rail mini-map with 4 subsection markers + scroll-driven 'you are here' marker.
p3c24.flecks: Subsection breather bands: three wide low-density fleck zones at 25/50/75% scroll approximating the (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) transitions + paragraph spacing 1.2em. Explicit per-ID rules only.
p3c24.openerComposition: Ledger. G: right-bleed '68'. S (slot banner tp-68): four full-width horizontal bands with air between them: (a) 2px lichen 55%, (b) 3px shaft 65%, (c) 2px lichen 35% (dimmed = falling), (d) 4px shaft 90%; each band's left end steps rightward (a→d staircase of 4% steps) so the stack reads as descent. T: title flush-left. R: gloss 'Gegenwärtigen' (attested p10: 'making present [Gegenwartigen]') + 4-marker mini-map (see giantsRelief).
p3c24.paletteRole: Mixed shaft/lichen across four weights; (c) band deliberately dimmest in cohort (falling register).
p3c24.readingTreatment: Threshold well on p:first-of-type. 38rem measure. Three subsection breather dividers + 1.2em paragraph spacing. Rail mini-map (4 ticks + scroll marker). See giantsRelief.

p3c25.contentRationale: GIANT II (55 paras, 6697w), three movements: (a) circumspect care — awaiting/retaining/making-present, 'knows its way around' (p12); (b) circumspection→theory — hammer 'too heavy' → mass (p33-34), place→position, 'world point' (p37), mathematical projection of nature (p38), thematization/objectification (p40); (c) transcendence — horizonal schemata, 'whereto of the ecstasy' (p47), world 'further outside than any object' (p52), 'subjective world more objective than any object' (p53). Opens with the book's own master sentence: 'ecstatic temporality clears the there' (p1). Opener: three horizons whose right ends EXTEND PAST THE FRAME with open (uncapped) line-ends = the whereto; at left, a small hammer tool-shadow dissolving dot-by-dot into a grid point (place→position, Um-schrankt→entschrankt p37). Long-chapter relief same as §68 with 3-marker mini-map.

p3c27.contentRationale: Grey close (9 paras): 'eternal yesterday' (p3); pallid lack of mood (p4); 'suffer dully' (p4); 'master the everyday in the Moment… only for the moment' (p4); 'everydayness = temporality' (p8). Deliberate diminuendo: the cohort's horizons collapse to ONE flat unbroken lichen-grey line (the eternal yesterday — no future-priority weight left); a single small bright notch interrupts it at center (the Moment that masters the everyday 'only for the moment' — small because it cannot extinguish it). Palest shaft usage in the cohort: light almost withdrawn, handing off to historicity. The flatline must read as grey on dark ground, not as a dimmed shaft — lichen-dominant by intent.
p3c27.flecks: NONE — monotony is the content ('like yesterday, so today and tomorrow', p6). Unbroken column.

Maximum air above and below — the emptiest slot in the cohort. T: title flush-left. R: gloss 'Alltäglichkeit' (attested in title 'Everydayness') + micro-caption 'the eternal yesterday'.
p3c27.paletteRole: Lichen-dominant; shaft appears ONLY in the 8px notch. Deliberate near-withdrawal of light (diminuendo into historicity cohort).
p3c27.readingTreatment: Threshold well on p:first-of-type. No dividers (monotony register). 34rem. The well itself is the only relief — then flatness.
